response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and broad experience across stacks and domains, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for client advisory and compliance work in a German-market consulting firm.
strengths: Extensive open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public tools
Proven full-stack expertise across Linux, Node.js, DLang, and cloud infrastructures
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops/courses
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not C1 as required
No clear evidence of UML modeling, architectural design documentation, or formal project leadership
Lacks demonstrated experience in IT security, risk management, or compliance advisory for clients
